dog.description_text:
Dolly Pawton is a 6-month-old chug who weighs around 9 lbs and somehow looks permanently unimpressed with the world. Between her little frown and that underbite, she has a face that is very hard not to love.

She’s a sweetheart who really bonds with her person and likes staying close. Meeting new people is a little harder for her. Dolly is very shy at first and will usually hang back or tuck herself behind the person she trusts while she figures things out. She just needs some time and patience, and once she starts feeling safe, she slowly warms up.

Dolly does well with other dogs and has been living happily with a 1-year-old Yorkie. She enjoys meeting dogs and is friendly with them, though she doesn’t need to be playing with them all the time. She’s also house-trained and already settling into a nice routine for such a young pup.

Registered adopters interested in Dolly Pawton can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
